list-of-allocated-amateur-radio-callsign.contentsIndicative: one worksheet, 'Allocated CallSign as at 260320': header Value,Status then 92,318 data rows, Status 'Allocated' on every row. This is the faithful witness (Ofcom asset id 196168). Ofcom also published a strictly-corrupted companion of the same disclosure (asset id 194533), now held in full as amateur-radio-allocated-call-signs.xlsx and recorded in this entry's divergences[] - it is not ingested. Anomalies in this faithful copy, preserved verbatim: three trailing non-breaking spaces (2E1HON, G0TQK, G7IWE), one interior space (G6 FMU), two non-uppercase callsigns (2e1GTD, g0jrk), 388 four-character heritage callsigns and 51 callsigns of six to nine characters (mostly reciprocal M/... forms).

raw-extract-sheet-1-allocated-callsign-a.contentsIndicative: mechanical extract of the sole worksheet; header Value,Status then 92,318 rows. Status 'Allocated' throughout. All anomalies preserved verbatim (trailing non-breaking spaces, interior space, non-uppercase callsigns, heritage four-character and over-length reciprocal callsigns).

normalised--sheet-1-allocated-callsign-a.contentsIndicative: header callsign,status,licence_class; 92,318 rows sorted by callsign (source order carries no meaning). Status carried verbatim ('Allocated' on every row - a genuine per-row column, not a declared attribution); licence_class emitted empty (no class disclosed). Three trailing non-breaking spaces were trimmed from callsigns and counted in the converter notes (never silent); the interior-space 'G6 FMU' and the non-uppercase callsigns are preserved verbatim.

amateur-radio-allocated-call-signs.xlsx.contentsIndicative: Ofcom companion asset id 194533, held in full so the divergence is re-verifiable forever. Carries the same 92,318 logical callsigns as the faithful copy, but eleven suffix-month callsigns were mangled by Excel into date serials (enumerated in the divergences[] record). Deliberately not the entry's parse source - a strictly-corrupted variant kept as evidence, never ingested. Recovered byte-identical (sha256 matches) from the UK Government Web Archive's id_ (raw) replay of the Ofcom asset.

divergences.summary: Ofcom published two copies of this disclosure: the faithful asset 196168 and a companion asset 194533 in which eleven suffix-month callsigns were mangled by Excel into date serials. Both carry the same 92,318 logical callsigns; only these eleven cells differ. Which copy is faithful is stated, not adjudicated - both are held so a reader can compare them directly.
